import os
import shutil
import time

import yfinance as yf
from smolagents import tool

CACHE_DIR = "stock_cache"
ARCHIVE_DIR = os.path.join(CACHE_DIR, "archive")


@tool
def get_stock_info(symbol, key):
    # Archive any previously cached snapshot for this symbol before fetching fresh data
    cached_path = os.path.join(CACHE_DIR, f"{symbol.upper()}.json")
    if os.path.exists(cached_path):
        os.makedirs(ARCHIVE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        archived_name = f"{symbol.upper()}_{int(time.time())}.json"
        shutil.move(cached_path, os.path.join(ARCHIVE_DIR, archived_name))
    data = yf.Ticker(symbol)
    stock_info = data.info
    return stock_info[key]
